title: redis vs memcached
linkedin:
Use Redis by default.

It does everything Memcached does, then adds real data types, optional persistence, atomic counters, queues, and pub/sub, so one engine covers caching plus sessions, rate limiting, and leaderboards. Pick Memcached only for a dead-simple, very large, multi-threaded cache of plain string values. Both are sub-millisecond fast, so speed rarely decides it.

Read the full guide: https://www.kloudbean.com/blog/redis-vs-memcached/
